channels.name: The Futur
channels.description: Chris Do — Emmy-winning designer who built his motion-design company Blind into an $80M+ business (Nike, Sony, Google as clients) before founding The Futur. 2.6M subscribers. Explicitly built around Mindset, Marketing, Sales & Negotiations, and Pricing — the business side of design, not tutorials.
channels.focus: Business of design — pricing, sales, client management
channels.verificationMethod: This category was a genuine dead end earlier in this project; found via a fresh attempt with different search terms. Fetched the channel directly — About section and keywords ('freelance business', 'pricing', 'creative business', 'designer salary') are an exact match. One of the most established, well-documented channels found in this entire session.

notes: This category came up empty on an earlier attempt in this project — worth noting that persistence with different search angles (this time: 'freelance graphic designer business pricing clients' instead of just 'Nigerian graphic designer') found a genuinely excellent match.
